## Activity

During January 2024, the clinic team at River Outreach completed 49 captures. This activity records the total number of image captures completed during the month and provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading review. The reported activity was documented for routine operational monitoring.

## Image quality

Of the completed captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 10.2 per cent. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not be assessed and should be considered when reviewing the overall effectiveness of the capture process. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and ongoing operational improvement.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 0 days, indicating that the midpoint of reported grading times was recorded as 0. Together, these results summarise the grading workload and the timeliness of review for the January 2024 activity at River Outreach.
